Replicated Load-Balanced Services复制与负载均衡服务

— PDF 第 73 页 —

The simplest distributed pattern, and one that most are familiar with, is a replicated load-balanced service. In such a service, every server is identical to every other server, and all are capable of supporting traffic from any client. The pattern consists of a scalable number of servers with a load balancer in front of them. The load balancer is typically either completely round-robin or uses some form of session stickiness. The chapter will give a concrete example of how to deploy such a service in Kubernetes.

最简单、也是大多数人最熟悉的分布式模式，就是复制与负载均衡服务。在这种服务中，每台服务器都与其他服务器完全相同，并且都有能力承接来自任意客户端的流量。该模式由数量可伸缩的服务器、以及位于它们前方的负载均衡器组成。负载均衡器通常要么完全轮询（round-robin），要么使用某种形式的会话粘滞。本章将给出在 Kubernetes 中部署这种服务的具体示例。

Stateless Services无状态服务

Stateless services are ones that don’t require saved state to operate correctly. In the simplest stateless applications, even individual requests may be routed to separate instances of the service (see Figure 6-1). Examples of stateless services include things like static content servers and complex middleware systems that receive and aggregate responses from numerous different backend systems.

无状态服务是指那些不需要保存状态就能正确运行的服务。在最简单的无状态应用中，甚至单个请求都可以被路由到服务的不同实例（见图 6-1）。无状态服务的例子包括静态内容服务器，以及接收并聚合来自众多不同后端系统响应的复杂中间件系统。

— PDF 第 74 页 —

Stateless systems are replicated to provide redundancy and scale. No matter how small your service is, you need at least two replicas to provide a service with a “highly available” service level agreement (SLA). To understand why this is true, consider trying to deliver a three-nines (99.9% availability). In a three-nines service, you get 1.4 minutes of downtime per day (24 × 60 × 0.001). Assuming that you have a service that never crashes, that still means you need to be able to do a software upgrade in less than 1.4 minutes in order to hit your SLA with a single instance. And that’s assuming that you do daily software rollouts. If your team is really embracing continuous delivery and you’re pushing a new version of software every hour, you need to be able to do a software rollout in 3.6 seconds to achieve your 99.9% uptime SLA with a single instance. Any longer than that, and you will have more than 0.01% downtime from those 3.6 seconds. And all of this is assuming that your code never fails due to bugs, which is unrealistic in any real-world codebase.

无状态系统之所以要被复制，是为了提供冗余和扩展性。无论你的服务多小，你都至少需要两个副本才能提供一个具备“高可用”服务等级协议（SLA）的服务。要理解为什么如此，不妨考虑一下要达到三个九（99.9% 可用性）意味着什么。在三个九的服务中，你每天只有 1.4 分钟的停机时间（24 × 60 × 0.001）。假设你的服务从不崩溃，那仍然意味着你必须在不到 1.4 分钟内完成一次软件升级，才能在单实例下达成 SLA——而且这还是假设你每天才发版一次。如果你的团队真正践行持续交付，每小时就推送一个新版本，那你就必须在 3.6 秒内完成一次软件发布，才能在单实例下达到 99.9% 的正常运行时间 SLA。超过这个时间，那 3.6 秒带来的停机就会超过 0.01%。而所有这些，都还假设你的代码从不出 bug——这在任何真实代码库中都是不现实的。

Of course, instead of all of that work, you could just have two replicas of your service with a load balancer in front of them. That way, while you are doing a rollout, or in the—unlikely, I’m sure—event that your software crashes, your users will be served by the other replica of the service and never know anything was going on.

当然，与其做这么多工作，你不如直接给服务准备两个副本，前面放一个负载均衡器。这样，当你在发版时，或者在——我确信不太可能——软件崩溃时，你的用户会由另一个副本提供服务，完全察觉不到正在发生什么。

As services grow larger, they are also replicated to support additional users. Horizontally scalable systems handle more and more users by adding more replicas; see Figure 6-2. They achieve this with the load-balanced replicated serving pattern.

随着服务规模增大，还会通过复制来支持更多用户。水平可扩展的系统通过增加更多副本来承接越来越多的用户；见图 6-2。它们借助负载均衡的复制服务模式来做到这一点。

Readiness Probes for Load Balancing用于负载均衡的就绪探针

Of course, simply replicating your service and adding a load balancer is only part of a complete pattern for stateless replicated serving. When designing a replicated service, it is equally important to build and deploy a readiness probe to inform the load balancer. We have discussed how health probes can be used by a container orchestration system to determine when an application needs to be restarted. In contrast, a readiness probe determines when an application is ready to serve user requests. The reason for the differentiation is that many applications require some time to become initialized before they are ready to serve. They may need to connect to databases, load plugins, or download serving files from the network. In all of these cases, the containers are alive, but they are not ready. When building an application for a replicated service pattern, be sure to include a special URL that implements this readiness check.

当然，仅仅复制服务并加一个负载均衡器，只是无状态复制服务完整模式的一部分。在设计复制服务时，构建并部署一个就绪探针（readiness probe）来通知负载均衡器同样重要。我们已经讨论过容器编排系统如何使用健康探针来判断何时需要重启应用；与之相对，就绪探针判断的是应用何时准备好服务用户请求。之所以要做这种区分，是因为很多应用在就绪之前需要一段时间来完成初始化——它们可能需要连接数据库、加载插件，或从网络下载服务所需文件。在所有这些情况下，容器是存活的，但还没就绪。在为复制服务模式构建应用时，务必包含一个专门的 URL 来实现这种就绪检查。

— PDF 第 75 页 —

Hands On: Creating a Replicated Service in Kubernetes动手实践：在 Kubernetes 中创建复制服务

The instructions below give a concrete example of how to deploy a stateless replicated service behind a load balancer. These directions use the Kubernetes container orchestrator, but the pattern can be implemented on top of a number of different container orchestrators.

下面的步骤给出了一个具体示例：如何在负载均衡器后面部署一个无状态复制服务。这些步骤使用 Kubernetes 容器编排器，但该模式同样可以在许多其他容器编排器之上实现。

To begin with, we will create a small Node.js application that serves definitions of words from the dictionary.

首先，我们将创建一个小型 Node.js 应用，它根据字典提供单词释义服务。

To try this service out, you can run it using a container image:

要试用这个服务，你可以用容器镜像直接运行：

docker run -p 8080:8080 brendanburns/dictionary-server

This runs a simple dictionary server on your local machine. For example, you can visit http://localhost:8080/dog to see the definition for dog.

这会在你本机上启动一个简单的字典服务器。例如，你可以访问 http://localhost:8080/dog 来查看 dog 这个词的释义。

If you look at the logs for the container, you’ll see that it starts serving immediately but only reports readiness after the dictionary (which is approximately 8 MB) has been downloaded over the network.

如果你查看该容器的日志，会发现它立即开始服务，但只有在字典（约 8 MB）通过网络下载完成之后才会报告就绪。

To deploy this in Kubernetes, you create a Deployment:

要在 Kubernetes 中部署它，你需要创建一个 Deployment：

apiVersion: extensions/v1beta1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: dictionary-server
spec:
  replicas: 3
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: dictionary-server
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: server
        image: brendanburns/dictionary-server
        ports:
        - containerPort: 8080
        readinessProbe:
          httpGet:
            path: /ready
            port: 8080
          initialDelaySeconds: 5
          periodSeconds: 5

You can create this replicated stateless service with:

你可以用下面的命令创建这个复制的无状态服务：

kubectl create -f dictionary-deploy.yaml

Now that you have a number of replicas, you need a load balancer to bring requests to your replicas. The load balancer serves to distribute the load as well as to provide an

现在你已经有了多个副本，还需要一个负载均衡器把请求分发到这些副本上。负载均衡器既用于分发负载，也用于提供一层抽象，将被复制的服务与服务的消费者隔离开来。

— PDF 第 76 页 —

abstraction to separate the replicated service from the consumers of the service. The load balancer also provides a resolvable name that is independent of any of the specific replicas.

负载均衡器还提供一个可解析的名称，该名称独立于任何具体副本。

With Kubernetes, you can create this load balancer with a Service object:

在 Kubernetes 中，你可以用一个 Service 对象来创建这个负载均衡器：

kind: Service
apiVersion: v1
metadata:
  name: dictionary-server-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: dictionary-server
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 8080
      targetPort: 8080

Once you have the configuration file, you can create the dictionary service with:

准备好配置文件后，你可以用下面的命令创建字典服务：

kubectl create -f dictionary-service.yaml

Session Tracked Services会话跟踪服务

The previous examples of the stateless replicated pattern routed requests from all users to all replicas of a service. While this ensures an even distribution of load and fault tolerance, it is not always the preferred solution. Often there are reasons for wanting to ensure that a particular user’s requests always end up on the same machine. Sometimes this is because you are caching that user’s data in memory, so landing on the same machine ensures a higher cache hit rate. Sometimes it is because the interaction is long-running in nature, so some amount of state is maintained between requests. Regardless of the reason, an adaption of the stateless replicated service pattern is to use session tracked services, which ensure that all requests for a single user map to the same replica, as illustrated in Figure 6-3.

前面这些无状态复制模式的例子，把所有用户的请求都路由到服务的所有副本。虽然这保证了负载均匀分布和容错，但它并不总是首选方案。很多时候，我们有理由希望确保某个特定用户的请求总是落到同一台机器上。有时是因为你把该用户的数据缓存在内存里，落到同一台机器可以保证更高的缓存命中率；有时是因为交互本身是长连接的，请求之间需要维护一定的状态。无论原因如何，无状态复制服务模式的一个变体是使用会话跟踪服务：它确保单个用户的所有请求都映射到同一个副本，如图 6-3 所示。

— PDF 第 77 页 —

Generally speaking, this session tracking is performed by hashing the source and destination IP addresses and using that key to identify the server that should service the requests. So long as the source and destination IP addresses remain constant, all requests are sent to the same replica.

一般来说，这种会话跟踪是通过对源 IP 和目的 IP 地址做哈希、并用该哈希值作为键来识别应当服务请求的服务器。只要源 IP 和目的 IP 地址保持不变，所有请求都会被发送到同一个副本。

IP-based session tracking works within a cluster (internal IPs) but generally doesn’t work well with external IP addresses because of network address translation (NAT). For external session tracking, application-level tracking (e.g., via cookies) is preferred.

基于 IP 的会话跟踪在集群内部（内网 IP）有效，但由于网络地址转换（NAT），它通常不适用于外部 IP 地址。对于外部会话跟踪，更推荐使用应用层跟踪（例如通过 cookie）。

Often, session tracking is accomplished via a consistent hashing function. The benefit of a consistent hashing function becomes evident when the service is scaled up or down. Obviously, when the number of replicas changes, the mapping of a particular user to a replica may change. Consistent hashing functions minimize the number of users that actually change which replica they are mapped to, reducing the impact of scaling on your application.

会话跟踪通常通过一致性哈希函数来实现。一致性哈希函数的好处，在服务扩容或缩容时会变得明显。显然，当副本数量发生变化时，某个特定用户到副本的映射可能会改变。一致性哈希函数能把实际发生映射变更的用户数量降到最少，从而降低扩缩容对应用的冲击。

Application-Layer Replicated Services应用层复制服务

In all of the preceding examples, the replication and load balancing takes place in the network layer of the service. The load balancing is independent of the actual protocol that is being spoken over the network, beyond TCP/IP. However, many applications use HTTP as the protocol for speaking with each other, and knowledge of the application protocol that is being spoken enables further refinements to the replicated stateless serving pattern for additional functionality.

在前面所有例子中，复制与负载均衡都发生在服务的网络层。这种负载均衡独立于网络上实际通信的协议——它只基于 TCP/IP。然而，许多应用使用 HTTP 作为彼此通信的协议；了解所使用的应用层协议，就能对复制无状态服务模式做进一步细化，从而提供更多功能。

Introducing a Caching Layer引入缓存层

Sometimes the code in your stateless service is still expensive despite being stateless. It might make queries to a database to service requests or do a significant amount of rendering or data mixing to service the request. In such a world, a caching layer can make a great deal of sense. A cache exists between your stateless application and the end-user request. The simplest form of caching for web applications is a caching web proxy. The caching proxy is simply an HTTP server that maintains the correct responses to user requests in memory. If two users request the same web page or API call, only one request will go to your backend; the other will be serviced out of memory in the cache. This is illustrated in Figure 6-4.

有时，尽管你的无状态服务是无状态的，其代码代价仍然很高。它可能需要查询数据库才能服务请求，或者需要做大量渲染或数据混合来响应请求。在这种情况下，加一层缓存就非常有意义了。缓存位于你的无状态应用与最终用户请求之间。对 Web 应用来说，最简单的缓存形式是一个缓存 Web 代理。这个缓存代理就是一个 HTTP 服务器，它在内存中维护着用户请求的正确响应。如果两个用户请求同一个网页或同一个 API 调用，只有一个请求会到达你的后端；另一个请求则直接从缓存内存中返回。如图 6-4 所示。

— PDF 第 78 页 —

For our purposes, we will use Varnish, an open source web cache.

在本例中，我们将使用 Varnish——一个开源的 Web 缓存。

Deploying Your Cache部署缓存

The simplest way to deploy the web cache is alongside each instance of your web server using the sidecar pattern (see Figure 6-5).

部署 Web 缓存最简单的方式，是使用边车模式把它放在你的每个 Web 服务器实例旁边（见图 6-5）。

Though this approach is simple, it has some disadvantages, namely that you will have to scale your cache at the same scale as your web servers. This is often not the approach you want. For your cache, you want as few replicas as possible with lots of resources for each replica (e.g., rather than 10 replicas with 1 GB of RAM each, you’d want two replicas with 5 GB of RAM each). To understand why this is preferable, consider that every page will be stored in every replica. With 10 replicas, you will store every page 10 times, reducing the overall set of pages that you can keep in memory in the cache. This causes a reduction in the hit rate, the fraction of the time that a request can be served out of cache, which in turn decreases the utility of the cache.

这种方式虽然简单，但也有缺点：你将不得不让缓存与 Web 服务器以相同的规模扩缩。这通常并不是你想要的。对于缓存，你希望副本尽可能少、但每个副本配备大量资源（例如，与其用 10 个各 1 GB 内存的副本，不如用 2 个各 5 GB 内存的副本）。要理解为什么这样更可取，请考虑：每个页面都会被存储在每个副本中。如果有 10 个副本，每个页面就会被存 10 份，从而减少了你能在缓存内存中保存的页面总量。这会导致命中率下降——即请求能从缓存直接命中的比例下降——进而降低缓存的效用。

Though you do want a few large caches, you might also want lots of small replicas of your web servers. Many languages (e.g., Node.js) can really only utilize a single core, and thus you want many replicas to be able to take advantage of multiple cores, even on the same machine. Therefore, it makes the most sense to configure your caching layer as a second stateless replicated serving tier above your web-serving tier, as illustrated in Figure 6-6.

虽然你希望缓存数量少而大，但你可能也希望 Web 服务器有大量小副本。许多语言（例如 Node.js）实际上只能利用单核，因此你需要大量副本才能利用多核，即使这些副本跑在同一台机器上。因此，最合理的做法是把缓存层配置为位于 Web 服务层之上的第二个无状态复制服务层，如图 6-6 所示。

— PDF 第 79 页 —

Unless you are careful, caching can break session tracking. The reason for this is that if you use default IP address affinity and load balancing, all requests will be sent from the IP addresses of the cache, not the end user of your service. If you’ve followed the advice previously given and deployed a few large caches, your IP-address-based affinity may in fact mean that some replicas of your web layer see no traffic. Instead, you need to use something like a cookie or HTTP header for session tracking.

除非你小心处理，否则缓存可能会破坏会话跟踪。原因在于：如果你使用默认的 IP 地址亲和与负载均衡，所有请求都将来自缓存的 IP 地址，而不是你服务的最终用户的 IP。如果你听从了前面的建议、部署了几个大缓存，那么基于 IP 地址的亲和性实际上可能意味着你的 Web 层某些副本根本收不到流量。因此，你需要改用 cookie 或 HTTP 头之类的方式来做会话跟踪。

Hands On: Deploying the Caching Layer动手实践：部署缓存层

The dictionary-server service we built earlier distributes traffic to the dictionary server and is discoverable as the DNS name dictionary-server. This pattern is illustrated in Figure 6-7.

我们之前构建的 dictionary-server 服务把流量分发到字典服务器，并可通过 DNS 名称 dictionary-server 被发现。该模式如图 6-7 所示。

We can begin building this with the following Varnish cache configuration:

我们可以用下面这份 Varnish 缓存配置来开始构建：

vcl 4.0;
backend default {
  .host = "dictionary-server-service";
  .port = "8080";
}

Create a ConfigMap object to hold this configuration:

创建一个 ConfigMap 对象来保存这份配置：

kubectl create configmap varnish-config --from-file=default.vcl
— PDF 第 80 页 —

Now we can deploy the replicated Varnish cache, which will load this configuration:

现在我们可以部署复制的 Varnish 缓存，它会加载这份配置：

apiVersion: extensions/v1beta1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: varnish-cache
spec:
  replicas: 2
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: varnish-cache
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: cache
        resources:
          requests:
            # We'll use two gigabytes for each varnish cache
            memory: 2Gi
        image: brendanburns/varnish
        command:
        - varnishd
        - -F
        - -f
        - /etc/varnish-config/default.vcl
        - -a
        - 0.0.0.0:8080
        - -s
        # This memory allocation should match the memory request above
        - malloc,2G
        ports:
— PDF 第 81 页 —
- containerPort: 8080
        volumeMounts:
        - name: varnish
          mountPath: /etc/varnish-config
      volumes:
      - name: varnish
        configMap:
          name: varnish-config

You can deploy the replicated Varnish servers with:

你可以用下面的命令部署这些复制的 Varnish 服务器：

kubectl create -f varnish-deploy.yaml

And then finally deploy a load balancer for this Varnish cache:

最后，为这个 Varnish 缓存部署一个负载均衡器：

kind: Service
apiVersion: v1
metadata:
  name: varnish-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: varnish-cache
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 80
      targetPort: 8080

which you can create with:

你可以用下面的命令创建它：

kubectl create -f varnish-service.yaml

Expanding the Caching Layer扩展缓存层

Now that we have inserted a caching layer into our stateless replicated service, let’s look at what this layer can provide beyond standard caching. HTTP reverse proxies like Varnish are generally pluggable and can provide a number of advanced features that are useful beyond caching.

现在我们已经在无状态复制服务中插入了一层缓存，让我们看看这一层除了标准缓存之外还能提供什么。像 Varnish 这样的 HTTP 反向代理通常是可插拔的，能够提供许多超越缓存本身的高级功能。

Rate Limiting and Denial-of-Service Defense限流与拒绝服务防御

Few of us build sites with the expectation that we will encounter a denial-of-service attack. But as more and more of us build APIs, a denial of service can come simply from a developer misconfiguring a client or a site-reliability engineer accidentally running a load test against a production installation. Thus, it makes sense to add general denial-of-service defense via rate limiting to the caching layer. Most HTTP reverse proxies like Varnish have capabilities along this line. In particular, Varnish has a throttle module that can be configured to provide throttling based on IP address and request path, as well as whether or not a user is logged in.

我们中很少有人在建站时期待会遇到拒绝服务攻击。但随着越来越多人构建 API，一次拒绝服务可能仅仅源于开发者错误配置了客户端，或站点可靠性工程师不小心对生产环境跑了一次压测。因此，在缓存层通过限流加入通用的拒绝服务防御是合理的。大多数像 Varnish 这样的 HTTP 反向代理都具备这方面的能力。特别是 Varnish，它有一个限流模块，可以配置为基于 IP 地址和请求路径、以及用户是否已登录来做限流。

— PDF 第 82 页 —

If you are deploying an API, it is generally a best practice to have a relatively small rate limit for anonymous access and then force users to log in to obtain a higher rate limit. Requiring a login provides auditing to determine who is responsible for the unexpected load, and also offers a barrier to would-be attackers who need to obtain multiple identities to launch a successful attack.

如果你在部署 API，一般最佳实践是：对匿名访问设置相对较小的限流，然后强制用户登录以获得更高的限流额度。要求登录既提供了审计能力，可以确定是谁造成了异常负载，也对潜在攻击者形成了一道门槛——他们必须获取多个身份才能发起一次成功的攻击。

When a user hits the rate limit, the server will return the 429 error code indicating that too many requests have been issued. However, many users want to understand how many requests they have left before hitting that limit. To that end, you will likely also want to populate an HTTP header with the remaining-calls information. Though there isn’t a standard header for returning this data, many APIs return some variation of X-RateLimit-Remaining.

当用户触达限流时，服务器会返回 429 错误码，表示请求过多。然而，许多用户希望知道在触达上限之前还剩多少次请求。为此，你可能还希望在 HTTP 头中填入剩余调用次数的信息。虽然并没有一个标准头来返回这些数据，但许多 API 都会返回某种形式的 X-RateLimit-Remaining 头。

While Varnish can provide some basic protection against DDoS attacks, in the real world attackers are often sophisticated organizations with large amounts of resources to bring to bear in ever-evolving attacks against organizations. If you are planning on deploying large-scale or mission-critical infrastructure, you will probably also want to add cloud-based denial of service protection from a public cloud provider to your application. Cloud-based DDoS systems can handle significantly more load and also are constantly evolving to meet the changing landscape of threat actors.

虽然 Varnish 能提供一些基本的 DDoS 防护，但在现实世界中，攻击者往往是成熟的组织，拥有大量资源，并以不断演进的方式对各组织发起攻击。如果你打算部署大规模或关键业务基础设施，你可能还希望在应用之上叠加来自公有云厂商的云 DDoS 防护。云端 DDoS 系统能承受大得多的负载，并且也在不断演进以应对不断变化的威胁态势。

SSL TerminationSSL 终结

In addition to performing caching for performance, one of the other common tasks performed by the edge layer is SSL termination. Even if you plan on using SSL for communication between layers in your cluster, you should still use different certificates for the edge and your internal services. Indeed, each individual internal service should use its own certificate to ensure that each layer can be rolled out independently. Unfortunately, the Varnish web cache can’t be used for SSL termination, but fortunately, the nginx application can. Thus, we want to add a third layer to our stateless application pattern, which will be a replicated layer of nginx servers that will handle SSL termination for HTTPS traffic and forward traffic on to our Varnish cache. HTTP traffic continues to travel to the Varnish web cache, and Varnish forwards traffic on to our web application, as shown in Figure 6-8.

除了为性能做缓存之外，边缘层承担的另一项常见任务是 SSL 终结。即使你计划在集群内各层之间也使用 SSL 通信，你仍然应该为边缘层和内部服务使用不同的证书。事实上，每个内部服务都应该使用自己的证书，以确保每一层都能独立发版。遗憾的是，Varnish Web 缓存不能用于 SSL 终结；但幸运的是，nginx 可以。因此，我们希望在无状态应用模式中再加一层：这是一个由 nginx 服务器组成的复制层，它负责对 HTTPS 流量做 SSL 终结，并把流量转发到我们的 Varnish 缓存。HTTP 流量继续直接到达 Varnish Web 缓存，Varnish 再把流量转发到我们的 Web 应用，如图 6-8 所示。

— PDF 第 83 页 —

Hands On: Deploying nginx and SSL Termination动手实践：部署 nginx 与 SSL 终结

The following instructions describe how to add a replicated SSL terminating nginx to the replicated service and cache that we previously deployed.

下面的步骤描述如何为我们之前部署的复制服务与缓存，再加一层做 SSL 终结的复制 nginx。

These instructions assume that you have a certificate. If you need to obtain a certificate, the easiest way to do that is via the tools at Let’s Encrypt. Alternatively, you can use the openssl tool to create them. The following instructions assume that you’ve named them server.crt (public certificate) and server.key (private key on the server). Such self-signed certificates will cause security alerts in modern web browsers and should never be used for production.

以下步骤假设你已经有了证书。如果你需要获取证书，最简单的方式是通过 Let’s Encrypt 的工具；或者，你也可以用 openssl 工具自己生成。下面的步骤假设你已将公证书命名为 server.crt，将服务器上的私钥命名为 server.key。这种自签名证书会在现代 Web 浏览器中触发安全警告，绝不能用于生产环境。

The first step is to upload your certificate as a secret to Kubernetes:

第一步是把你的证书作为 secret 上传到 Kubernetes：

kubectl create secret tls ssl --cert=server.crt --key=server.key

Once you have uploaded your certificate as a secret, you need to create an nginx configuration to serve SSL:

把证书作为 secret 上传后，你需要创建一份用于 SSL 服务的 nginx 配置：

events {
  worker_connections  1024;
}

http {
  server {
    listen 443 ssl;
    server_name my-domain.com www.my-domain.com;
— PDF 第 84 页 —
    ssl on;
    ssl_certificate         /etc/certs/tls.crt;
    ssl_certificate_key     /etc/certs/tls.key;
    location / {
        proxy_pass http://varnish-service:80;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
    }
  }
}

As with Varnish, you need to transform this into a ConfigMap object:

与 Varnish 一样，你需要把这份配置转换成一个 ConfigMap 对象：

kubectl create configmap nginx-conf --from-file=nginx.conf

Now that you have a secret and an nginx configuration, it’s time to create the replicated stateless nginx layer:

现在你已经有了 secret 和 nginx 配置，是时候创建这个复制的无状态 nginx 层了：

apiVersion: extensions/v1beta1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: nginx-ssl
spec:
  replicas: 4
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: nginx-ssl
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: nginx
        image: nginx
        ports:
        - containerPort: 443
        volumeMounts:
        - name: conf
          mountPath: /etc/nginx
        - name: certs
          mountPath: /etc/certs
      volumes:
      - name: conf
        configMap:
          # This is the ConfigMap for nginx we created previously
          name: nginx-conf
      - name: certs
        secret:
          # This is the secret we created above
          secretName: ssl
— PDF 第 85 页 —

To create the replicated nginx servers, you use:

要创建这些复制的 nginx 服务器，使用：

kubectl create -f nginx-deploy.yaml

Finally, you can expose this nginx SSL server with a service:

最后，你可以用一个 Service 把这个 nginx SSL 服务器暴露出来：

kind: Service
apiVersion: v1
metadata:
  name: nginx-service
spec:
  selector:
    app: nginx-ssl
  type: LoadBalancer
  ports:
    - protocol: TCP
      port: 443
      targetPort: 443

To create this load-balancing service, run:

要创建这个负载均衡服务，运行：

kubectl create -f nginx-service.yaml

If you create this service on a Kubernetes cluster that supports external load balancers, this will create an externalized, public service that services traffic on a public IP address.

如果你在一个支持外部负载均衡器的 Kubernetes 集群上创建这个 Service，它会创建一个对外暴露的公共服务，在一个公网 IP 地址上承接流量。

To get this IP address, you can run:

要获取这个 IP 地址，你可以运行：

kubectl get services

You should then be able to access the service with your web browser.

之后你应该就能用 Web 浏览器访问该服务了。

Summary小结

This chapter began with a simple pattern for replicated stateless services. Then we saw how this pattern grows with two additional replicated load-balanced layers to provide caching for performance and SSL termination for secure web serving. This complete pattern for stateless replicated serving is shown in Figure 6-8.

本章从一个简单的复制无状态服务模式开始。随后我们看到，这个模式如何通过增加两个额外的复制负载均衡层而演进：一层用于缓存以提升性能，一层用于 SSL 终结以实现安全的 Web 服务。这个完整的无状态复制服务模式如图 6-8 所示。

This complete pattern can be deployed into Kubernetes using three Deployments and Service load balancers to connect the layers shown in Figure 6-8. The complete source for these examples can be found at this book’s GitHub repository.

这个完整模式可以通过三个 Deployment 和若干 Service 负载均衡器部署到 Kubernetes 中，把图 6-8 所示的各层连接起来。这些示例的完整源码可以在本书的 GitHub 仓库中找到。
